description: This source file defines a readonly struct 'PsCryptoMsg' used in the PDFsharp library for cryptography-related messaging within the PDF signing context. It includes properties for message identification and display purposes.

classes.name: PsCryptoMsg
classes.description: A readonly struct representing a cryptography message with an identifier and message string, providing properties for event identification and naming.

methods.name: EventId
methods.description: Returns an EventId constructed from the message's ID and name.

methods.name: EventName
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the message ID.
